description: T1. Bay Tree- Rear Garden: Fell in sections to ground level and treat the stump with eco-plugs to prevent regrowth.(No stump removal must be carried out before the  6 to 8 week period has elapsed, to ensure no root suckering occurs) The reason for removal is the proximity of the tree to the proposed development works (Permission Granted 24/04397/FULL) T2. Lime TreeRear Garden:Reduce new growth to previous reduction points (approx. 3.5m height & 1.5m- 2m spread), retaining good growth furnishings for crown development.Thin branch structure if necessary to help create an even balance.Do not leave stumps or snags, or compromise the structural integrity of the knuckles by making cuts larger than necessary.Remove dead branches throughout the crown area that are over 2.5cm in diameter, and inspect the crown for any adversities.Remove epicormic shoots from the lower trunk to the crown break.Cyclical crown management.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
